Welcome to Texas’ Our Little Miss 
Age Divisions 
0—2 years, 3—6 years, 7—9 years, 10—12 years, 13—15 years,  
16—20 years, 21—39 years, and 40+ years 
Some divisions may be split based on the number of entries. 
Required Competitions 
All age divisions must compete in Interview, Sportswear, and Party Dress/Evening Gown.  
Clothing guidelines and examples can be found here in this handbook as well as on our website. 
Optionals Offered 
We offer the following optionals at our state competition: 
Miss Photogenic, Livin’ Doll, Commercial Print Categories, Pro-Am Modeling,  
Optional Talent, Prettiest Eyes/Hair/Smile, Best Dress/Sportswear, Practice Interview,  
Popular Miss! 
Descriptions of all the optionals can be found on later pages in this handbook. 
Award Information 
The following awards will be awarded in each division: 
Overall Divisional Queen, Princess (Successor), Personality Plus,   
and Mini Queen, followed by Alternates, Semi Finalists, and Finalists 
Overall Divisional Winner’s Package: 
Official Our Little Miss Rhinestone Crown, Monogrammed Satin-Backed Banner,                      
Official Scepter, Robe (use for 1 year), Banner Pins,  
Rhinestone OLM pin, Community Appearances, Gifts,  
 Cash Scholarship*, and more! 
*Scholarship given if reign is fulfilled and winner MUST compete in the World Competition!   
Scholarship amounts are determined by number of contestants in each division 
Welcome to the Our Little Miss family!  We are excited to have you join us for our 2026 Uni-
versal Beauty State Scholarship  Competition!  Our Little Miss has been around for more 
than 64 years and is still going strong!   
Get ready to have a great time, have tons of fun, make memories that will last a lifetime!  
This serves as your handbook for the state competition.

FIRST REMEMBER THAT WE ARE A NATURAL 
PAGEANT SYSTEM!  ALL HAIR AND MAKE-UP 
MUST BE AGE APPROPRIATE! 
 
We want the CHILD to shine, NOT the clothes! 
EVENT WHAT IS IT? WHAT DO I WEAR? 
Close—Up  
Appraisal 
(Interview) 
 
 
 
 
This is a time for the judges to see  
contestants up close and get to know them 
better!  Chaperones for 0-2 contestants will 
introduce their contestant with their name, 
age (in months) and hometown.  They will 
then tell the judges 2 or 3 fun/interesting 
facts about their contestant. Contestants  
ages 3 and up will introduce themselves to  
the judges by stating their name, age, city, 
and state followed by a basic turn.   
Contestants will  then answer a set of  
age-appropriate questions. 
RECOMMENDED ATTIRE:  DRESS/  
SKIRT AND TOP/JACKET 
Think interviewing for a job!  
For younger contestants, we recommend  
a nice Sunday’s Best Dress or for boys slacks 
and button down shirt. For older  
contestants, we recommend a office style 
dress or skirt with top/jacket. We highly sug-
gest either no sparkle or very little sparkle on 
outfits!  Keep it simple and classic! 
See examples on the next page! 
Sportswear 
Personality 
 
Sportswear personality, all contestants will  
individually come to the microphone and in-
troduce themselves by stating their name, 
age, city, followed by fun fact about them. 
Then will step to the spot in front of judges 
and do a turn, continue off stage.  Once each 
contestant has modeled on stage, the whole 
age group will come back on stage for a pa-
rade of beauties. 
RECOMMENDED ATTIRE: 
SPORTSWEAR PERSONALITY 
Casual Wear should be a pant, short, or skirt 
outfit, or a dress that shows off their personal 
style. The outfit can be as simple or as formal 
as you would like! It should be modest,  
age—appropriate and should not be high glitz 
or costume looking. 
See examples on the next page! 
Party Dress 
(Beauty Wear) Party Dress / Evening Gown, Formal Wear is 
our Beauty Wear competition.  All contest-
ants will individually model their beauty wear 
on stage.  Once each contestant has modeled  
on stage, the whole age group will come  
back on stage for a parade of beauties. 
RECOMMENDED ATTIRE: 
BEAUTY DRESS 
Contestants ages 0—9 should wear a  
short pageant style dress while  
contestants ages 10 and up should  
wear a floor length gown. We love sparkle,  
but please no high glitz dresses! 
Ages 13+ are allowed to have one shoulder 
strap!  Boys should wear a suit or formal wear. 
See examples on the next page! 
Playtime  Playtime is a time for them to show their per-
sonalities and ability to get along with others.  
0-2 will go in and have floor time to get to 
know the other contestants in this group.  3 
and up will go in with their age group and 
play age appropriate group games. 
RECOMMENDED ATTIRE: 
PLAYTIME 
Playtime attire will be your state t-shirt with 
khaki shorts or skort, white socks, white tennis 
shoes 
See our website for examples! 
Additional clothing GUIDELINES 
We are a natural pageant system! Clothes should be modest, conservative, and age appropriate!   
These are the clothing rules that can not be broken: 
•No slits above the knee 
•No strapless outfits—1” straps for ages 0—12 and at least spaghetti straps or one shoulder strap for ages 13+ 
•No tattoos visible on stage or in interview (This includes 0—2 chaperones) 
•No exposed stomachs or midriffs 
•No overdone jewelry or make—up for younger divisions especially 
We are a natural pageant system! Clothes should be modest, conservative, and age appropriate!

Sample Stage (Subject to Change)  
Hands-On Regulation for 0—2 
ALL contestants in the 0-2 age division have a  
HANDS ON RULE  
for every competition. For safety purposes, the  
contestant’s chaperone must keep his/her hands on the  
contestant at ALL times during official competition.  
So don’t let go on stage!  Don’t let go in interview! 
This does not include the party or optional talent!  Let them 
dance and have fun at the party.  If they are competing in  
optional talent, the chaperone just needs to stand close to them. 
Modeling Formation  
0—2 Contestants: 
Chaperones will model their contestants (see rule below).  We recommend turning your baby around at 
the front X so the judges can see the back of their outfit/hair/etc.   Your baby can walk or be carried!   
It’s your choice!  Show off your baby, but remember….NO COACHING YOUR BABY ONSTAGE!  
Audience members can cheer for every contestant, but NO COACHING from the audience either! 
 
3 and up Contestants: 
Smile big!  Don’t forget eye contact with the judges!  Don’t go too fast or too slow!  We prefer a nice,    
natural model!  Contestants are free (not required) to do a step-step-turn or circle turn at the front X.   
We are a natural system and want natural modeling!  AVOID sassy walks, hands-on hips, kissy faces, etc.  
NO COACHING from the audience either! 
 
Group Line Up 
For Sportswear and Party Dress, each age division will model individually.  After everyone has modeled in 
that age group, the entire age group will go back on stage for a group line up.  We will most likely ask the 
group to turn around once to see back of outfits/hair/etc.  
 
On Stage Introductions/Questions 
For the beauty wear competition,  we will do a parade of beauties!  Each contestant (or baby chaperone) 
will say their name, age, and hometown on stage to introduce themselves.  They will then model beauty 
wear.  If the judges request it, ages 3 and up will also answer an age-appropriate onstage question.

Optional Competitions 
Miss Photogenic 
Do you have a beautiful photo? To enter Miss Photogenic, your photo  
must be emailed to texasolmpics@gmail.com by October 9, 2026.   
No late entries will be accepted.  Winner’s will receive a full page in the  
program book along with a crown and banner.  Glitz photos are not  
accepted.  Judging is based on beauty, clarity, and personality of photo.  
 
Livin’ Doll (Highly Recommended) 
Livin’ Doll is a fun competition that is judged solely on facial beauty  
and stage presence by a different panel of  judges. All you need is a 
beauty dress!  It can be the same dress that you will wear for the main 
competition or a different one! No rules for Livin’ Doll dress, so feel free 
to bring out the SPARKLE! This is a GREAT chance to practice your  
beauty modeling before the main competition. Winners will crowned 
right after the event! 
 
Divisions:  0—18 months, 19—36 months, 3—4 years, 5—6 years, 7—9 years, 10—12 years, 13—17 years, 18+ years 
Commercial Print Categories  
We love to see your print work! Enter your Portfolio, Best Head Shot, 
Tear Sheets, and/or Zed Cards! Commercial print is judged based on  
all photogenic aspects: beauty, personality, clarity, and variety. 
All entries must be turned in at Registration...do not mail these items!!! 
→ Portfolio: Must be submitted in a picture book of some kind. Must contain 5 or more 
different shots. Pictures can be any size and picture color does not matter. 
→ Best Head Shot:  You can enter as many photos as you like for Best Head Shot. Must be 
individual pictures and should be a head and shoulder shot. Size and color of picture 
does not matter. 
→ Tear Sheet: Have you ever been photographed for a magazine, newspaper, or any print 
item? If so, submit a copy of your work! Items must be fairly recent to your current age. 
Simply “tear” your work out and compete in Best Tear Sheet! 
→ Composite/Zed Cards: Do you have an official modeling composite/zed card that you 
use at auditions? If not, feel free to make one and enter the Best Comp/Zed Card Com-
petitions. Cards can be any size (5x7 is most popular) and on the front should be your 
best head shot and on the back should be a variety of your photos. Include your stats—
Eye Color, Hair Color, Height, Weight, and any other information you use to book jobs! 
Color or BW pictures are accepted! 
 
 
 
Optional competitions are offered for extra practice and opportunities for optional category awards.    
Optional competition results do NOT change the outcome of the official results.  All optional competitions are 
judged by a separate panel of judges.  The official judges do not know who enters or wins the optional categories.

Optional Competitions Continued 
Pro Am Modeling (Highly Recommended) 
This competition is a fun way to get stage practice while modeling your favorite 
outfits/costumes. Judging will be based on stage presentation, facial beauty,  
grooming, and overall personality.  Glitz and/or High Fashion model is not  
required. 1 score sheet per outfit will be given and a 1st, 2nd, and 3rd place will be 
awarded in each category per age division. This is also a great way to pick which 
sportswear and/or party dress/evening gown you want to use during official  
competition if you are having trouble deciding on one!  Competition clothing rules,  
do not apply for Pro Am Modeling! Enter as many as you like, but enter 5 or more  
and you will be eligible to win sweepstakes for your age division and possibly go on  
to compete in the Sweepstakes Challenge for the Model of the Year Title  
(crown, banner, & CASH prize)!  
 
If you enter more than 5 categories, we will take your 5 highest scores for the sweepstakes award. 
 
Categories: Sportswear, Party Dress/Evening Gown, Rainwear, High Fashion, State/Country Costume, Sleepwear, Western Wear, 
Coat/Cape Wear, Today’s Fad, School Uniform, Suede/Leather Wear, Animal Print, Character Costume, Vintage Wear,  TV/Movie 
Costume, Hat Wear, Team Wear, Under the Sea ,  Occupation Attire, Glamo Camo 
Optional Talent / Command Performance 
Do you love to perform?  Now is your chance!  Open to ALL age groups!  
1 score sheet per performance will be given and a 1st, 2nd, and 3rd place will  
be awarded in each category per age division. Please follow OLM guidelines for  
clothing. All acts must be appropriate for a family audience and talent time  
cannot exceed 2 minutes! Enter as many as you like, but enter 5 or more and  
you will be eligible to win sweepstakes for your age division and possibly go on  
to compete in the Sweepstakes Challenge for the Entertainer of the Year Title 
(crown, Banner, & CASH prize)!  
 
If you enter more than 5 categories, we will take your 5 highest scores for the sweepstakes award.  
 
Categories: Vocal, Dance, Twirling, Instrumental, and Other  
(Other includes Monologue, Art, Magic, Comedy, Juggling, Sign Language, Ventriloquism, etc.)  
Prettiest Eyes, Hair, Smile, Dress & Sportswear— 
One winner will be chosen per division per category. These will be judged throughout 
the entire pageant and the winners will be announced at Special Awards! 
This is an easy way to compete for extra awards! 
 
Practice Interview (Highly Recommended) 
This optional is intended to help you practice your interview skills before the  
actual event. You will go through a mock interview session and will be given a  
score sheet with your critiques.  This will allow you to feel more confident before  
entering the real event! 
 
Popular Miss— 
Sell ads for our program book and not only get discounts off your fees, but you will 
also gain points towards our Popular Miss Award.  If you sell 5 or more full page ads  
or a combination of sizes to make full pages, you will be in the running for this award.  
You will win a free entry to next season’s state competition, crown, and banner.

Sweepstakes Awards 
Sweepstakes Divisions 
0—2 years, 3—6 years, 7—12 years, 13+ years 
An overall sweepstakes award is given based on the entry requirements and the highest score 
in each optional entered.  Each sweepstakes award requires a certain amount of entries. 
Must have 10 or more contestants enter for cash payout 
Pro/Am Modeling, Command Performance Sweepstakes 
One winner per Sweepstakes Division. Banner, Trophy, and $50 CASH award  
will be presented to each Sweepstakes Divisional Winner.  
*Must enter at least 5 Pro/Am Modeling Categories for Pro/Am Modeling Sweepstakes 
*Must enter at least 5 Optional Talent Categories for Command Performance Sweepstakes 
**Must have 10 or more contestants enter for cash payout 
 
Sweepstakes Challenge 
(Pro/Am Modeling and Command Performance Only) 
Each Sweepstakes Division Winner will compete against each other during the Sweepstakes 
Challenge for a chance to win the grand prize of an additional $100 CASH award! 
Sweepstakes Challenge Details—All contestants that modeled 5 or more outfits or performed 5 or more  
talents will be recognized on stage! Then we will name the 4 Sweepstakes Division Winners for Pro/Am and 
the 4  Sweepstakes Division Winners for Command Performance Talent. Those winners will then re—compete 
against the other Sweepstakes Division Winners in their highest scoring Pro/Am or Command Performance 
Talent Event. Once every challenger has competed, we will then announce the Model of the Year and  
the Entertainer of the Year!  
Must have at least 10 or more contestants for cash payout. 
Texas’s Model of the Year & Entertainer of the Year 
will each receive a 
$100 CASH AWARD!!!

 Additional party tickets are $45 and can be purchased in

Looking for ways to raise money? 
PATRON LISTINGS 
Patron sponsors will be listed in the Official Program Book for only $10 per listing.  The best part of all…  
$8 of every $10 you submit from your patron sponsors will be applied to YOUR  pageant expenses!   Each listing will 
consist of your contestant’s name, patron’s name, and a good luck message or well wish!  
There is not a set limit on how many patron listings you are allowed to sell! 
 
HOW DOES IT WORK? / WHAT DO YOU DO? 
Ask friends/family/co-workers/anyone to send a good luck message or a well wish to your contestant  
for $10.  You collect the $10 from them and send the $10 to State Headquarters. When the $10 is received,  
$8 will be subtracted off of your state balance! Type their message in the form below by October 9, 2026. 
Send the money through  
Venmo (@texasOLM), Cash App ($texasolm), or through your invoice.
